newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunkers flat, demand modest.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers flat, demand modest.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were little changed amid modest demand of 10,000-15,000 tonnes, brokers said.
They said 380 cst fuel was priced at $86/87 a tonne, with 180 cst at $91/2. Antwerp prices were about $1 higher.
The Mediterranean was also was dull. "The market is very quiet. There has been very little enquiry over the last week or so," a Med broker said.
Augusta 380 cst was at a flat $93 and 180 cst was likewise unchanged at about $98, while in the Gulf, Fujairah prices were $96 and $100, respectively. --London newsroom +44 171 542 4088
